reportedSymptom: Remote participants are heard twice, including while the reporting user microphone is muted.

sourceEvidence.offsetConvention: Offsets refer to the exact retained minified UTF-8 artifact. Both Unicode character and UTF-8 byte offsets are zero based.

observations.observation: The retained client distinguishes screen_share_audio from microphone audio.
Screen companions require an exact lowercase :screen suffix after a standard hyphenated UUID; UUID hex matching is case insensitive.
The client screen-publication predicate includes both screen video and screen audio; eN removes only a validated companion suffix.
The publication policy rejects the local account screen companion for every source. When stream_on_demand is enabled, other screen publications subscribe only for the watching owner.
The on-demand subscription path is guarded by a rollout flag; it is not unconditional behavior for every official-client session.
New publications invoke eU. Subscribed audio elements are indexed by track SID, with separate metadata for screen audio.
The initial remote-publication subscription pass is also conditional on the rollout flag.
One watching owner is stored. With the rollout flag, the selected and previous owners screen publications are subscribed/unsubscribed together; own-account owners are skipped.

nativePolicy.identity: Canonicalize valid UUID owners case insensitively. Strip only a validated exact :screen suffix. Preserve all malformed or unknown identities verbatim.
nativePolicy.ownCompanion: Reject every publication from the authenticated local UUID screen companion, including explicitly selected screen audio.
nativePolicy.screenAudio: Default off. Permit audio only for the one explicitly selected normalized owner. Missing or empty owner/remote identities cannot select screen audio.
nativePolicy.otherMedia: Preserve ordinary audio, unknown audio sources and video, including other participants screen video, without arbitrary microphone deduplication.
nativePolicy.playbackGain: Apply the same subscription decision and deafen gate before playback; nonfinite gains are silent and finite gains are clamped to 0...2.
nativePolicy.parityQualification: Always requiring explicit screen-audio selection is a deliberate native refinement inspired by the official client conditional stream-on-demand path. It is not claimed as unconditional official-client behavior. Native screen video remains separately available.
nativePolicy.integrationScope: NativeCallController uses manual initial subscriptions, a serialized revision-guarded deny-before-allow worker, publication/reconnect callbacks and immediate gain gates. NativeCallViews provides per-screen sound controls. Failed signaling retains the failed request direction; explicit retry rejoins with autoSubscribe=false without globally ending the call.

verification.executionStatus: Passed in native-0.2.5-unit-shipping.xcresult; full suite: 315 logical tests in 34 suites, 0 failures and 0 skips. No real room or media capture.
coverage: own companion excluded for all media
finite gain clamping and nonfinite rejection
actual controller connect options disable automatic track subscription

limitations: No live account, room, microphone, camera or physical-device audio session was used in this subtask.
The reported doubled playback has not been reproduced here; these source findings do not prove its actual runtime cause.
A screen-audio publication can carry sound already present in microphone playback; avoiding its automatic playback prevents that possible second path without dropping ordinary voices.
This is a subscription/playback policy, not a finding that acoustic echo cancellation is defective or verified.
Manual subscription requests and defensive gain gates are not a measured zero-frame guarantee across all server or SDK races.

observations.observation: Auto subscription defaults true; this client explicitly supplies false.
Repeated preference short-circuits; preference is stored at line71 before signaling, so failures must retain direction.
Quick reconnect restores desired subscription intent.
Publication callbacks only while connected require an explicit initial pass after connect.
Remote playback starts before subscription callback; manual initial subscription is stronger than callback-only muting.
Echo cancellation already defaults true; no speculative microphone capture or AEC override added.
